fullPassage: Appropriate Technology Appropriate technology refers to technological solutions that are designed to suitably meet the specific needs of a community. Such technologies typically utilize locally available resources, so they reduce costs and promote local industries. These technologies are environmentally sustainable because they rely on renewable resources. Additionally, their designs are easy to use, which allows local communities to maintain the technologies without specialized training. The Warka Tower is one good example of appropriate technology. This tower helps with the lack of clean water in many regions. It employs natural processes to deliver 100 liters of clean water daily. It gathers rainwater in a pot at its base. Additionally, the tower captures fog and changes it into water drops that collect on nets, and then the water drops fall into the pot. One of the tower’s strengths is that it is simple. A small team can construct it in just one day by using eco-friendly materials like soil, wood, and natural fiber nets. Truly, the Warka Tower demonstrates how appropriate technology can solve local issues in a way that is affordable, effective, and eco-friendly.
title: Appropriate Technology
